title: Visa TAP data model
caption: The header signature and the two body objects, linked by the same nonce and signing key, plus the nested objects and the key format. Field names follow the unversioned specification read on 2026-10-11.
alt: Class diagram. SignatureInput covers @authority and @path and has created, expires, keyid, alg, nonce and tag. It links, through the same nonce and key, to an optional agenticConsumer (nonce, idToken, contextualData, kid, alg, signature) and an optional agenticPaymentContainer (nonce, kid, alg, signature, paymentCredentialsHash, cardMetadata, encrypted payload, browsingIOU). contextualData holds countryCode, zip, ipAddress and deviceData. The ID Token holds iss, sub, aud, exp, iat and obfuscated or masked email and phone claims. cardMetadata holds lastFour, paymentAccountReference and shortDescription. browsingIOU holds invoiceId, amount, cardAcceptorId, acquirerId, uri, sequenceCounter, paymentService, kid, alg and signature. A JWK with kty, kid, use, alg, n and e verifies the keyid and the ID Token.
